description: Picking any clip that carries the right action label already scores as well on action-level AUC as the retrieval comparator does. This file holds that comparison, pooled over the two query folds. "overall" is every query of both folds; "held_out" keeps only queries whose two skeletons were both held out. The values are the means of the two folds, rounded to three decimals as the manuscript reports them; the per-fold values are in fold_auc.json. Coverage matters: the exact-action baseline can only answer the queries where a clip of the same exact action exists.
